item.redstonelink.adv_come_find_me_in_th: Advancement Icon: Come Find Me in the End
tooltip.redstonelink.open_pairing: Sneak with empty offhand, then right-click to open pairing UI
tooltip.redstonelink.trigger_source.sign: This is an event signal with no full lifecycle or cross-chunk support
This is a state signal with full lifecycle and cross-chunk support
tooltip.redstonelink.hide_node.smart_gla: You must wear Smart Glasses to see and interact with this node
tooltip.redstonelink.hide_node.direction: You need to use the Directional Face Editor to add its input/output faces
tooltip.redstonelink.link_filter.open_ed: Sneak with empty offhand, then right-click to open the filter editor
tooltip.redstonelink.chunk_activator.mod: Info: links involving these nodes will temporarily load the target chunk when needed so the signal can arrive
Info: the chunk containing these nodes will stay resident-loaded
tooltip.redstonelink.chunk_activator.ope: Sneak with empty offhand, then right-click to open the chunk activator editor
tooltip.redstonelink.repeater.dual_ident: The repeater can act as both core and triggerSource
tooltip.redstonelink.repeater.open_edito: Sneak with empty offhand, then right-click to open the repeater editor
tooltip.redstonelink.trigger_linker: Right-click while standing with empty offhand to trigger linked cores
tooltip.redstonelink.sync_linker: Right-click while standing with empty offhand to send the configured sync power to linked cores once
tooltip.redstonelink.sync_linker.adjust_: Ctrl + Mouse Wheel adjusts the signal strength
tooltip.redstonelink.linker.crosschunk.f: Cross-chunk: linkers can only act as force-load objects and do not support resident mode
tooltip.redstonelink.aggregate_single_on: Split this aggregate into a single serial before right-click use
tooltip.redstonelink.quick_link.open_edi: Sneak with empty offhand, then right-click to open the cache editor
tooltip.redstonelink.quick_link.toggle_m: Press the Quick Link mode key to switch between serial and channel (default B)
tooltip.redstonelink.quick_link.clear_ca: Sneak and press the Quick Link mode key to clear the current mode data
tooltip.redstonelink.quick_link.toggle_a: Press middle mouse to cycle replace, append, and remove
tooltip.redstonelink.quick_link.collect: Left-click a valid node to collect the current cache
tooltip.redstonelink.quick_link.apply: Right-click while standing on a valid node or filter to apply the cache; in replace mode, an empty cache clears the target
tooltip.redstonelink.quick_link.visualiz: visualize: while standing, hold Ctrl and left-click a node or repeater to add it and query its links
visualize: while standing, hold Ctrl and right-click a node or repeater to remove it from the display
visualize: sneak and press the Quick Link mode key to clear all displayed objects
tooltip.redstonelink.smart_glasses.visua: Wear with an empty main hand: while standing, hold Ctrl and left-click to add a displayed link target, hold Ctrl and right-click to remove it, Shift+B clears all
tooltip.redstonelink.smart_glasses.face_: Ctrl+K toggles persistent directional face vectors; this display condition is unioned with the Directional Face Editor
tooltip.redstonelink.smart_node_containe: Press the Quick Link mode key to open the container (default B)
Press middle mouse to cycle the current placement type
Hold Ctrl and scroll to temporarily select one node within the current placement type; after one successful use it returns to the default order
Right-click with the main hand to eject one node of the selected type and try to place it
Sneak and right-click a node with the main hand to recover it; overflow falls back to dropped items
Sneak and main-hand right-click a filter or chunk activator to make it drop directly as items
When nodes are stored inside, connection info tooltips do not auto-sync to outside changes, just like a vanilla chest
tooltip.redstonelink.graph_visual_editor: Right-click to export the current visible serial graph and open the graph page
Reuses an existing local graph asset when the structure checksum is unchanged
tooltip.redstonelink.directional_face_ed: Right-click a supported node face to edit the face set with the current mode
tooltip.redstonelink.state_panel.validat: New subscriptions only accept allocated and non-retired nodes
tooltip.redstonelink.state_panel.auto_re: Automatically refresh once after new subscriptions are added
